_doc: Real MIDAS events from a sampic-to-midas demonstrator file: four FE boards, an AC00 collector record per event, and AT00 telemetry that is actually filled. The run 108 fixture beside this one is a single-board repackaged recording and can exercise none of that. Raw bank bytes here beside what mdqm.dqm.sampic decodes from them, so tests/js/adbank.test.js checks the browser decoder against bytes nobody in this repository wrote. Regenerate with scripts/capture-demonstrator-events.py.
